documentation.summary: How 15+ agentic coding tools handle git isolation, worktrees, and parallel agents. The ecosystem has converged on two patterns: VM/container-per-task (hosted tools: Devin, Copilot Coding Agent, OpenHands) and git worktree-per-agent (local tools: Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code Background Agents). Claude Code CLI v2.1.49 shipped native worktree support in February 2026. Full report at .claude/research/agentic-coding-worktree-patterns.md

common_patterns.when_to_use: Each subagent/chunk-coder gets its own branch + directory automatically
common_patterns.example: Add 'isolation: worktree' to chunk-coder agent YAML front matter

common_patterns.when_to_use: Universal pattern for local multi-agent tools
Hosted cloud tools (Devin, GitHub Copilot Coding Agent, OpenHands)
common_patterns.example: Each task gets its own ephemeral GitHub Actions runner or cloud VM

common_patterns.when_to_use: Per-tool-use checkpointing without affecting user git history
common_patterns.example: Used by Cline and Kiro — stores snapshots in ext global storage

common_patterns.when_to_use: Agent runs in Docker container, outputs git diff as patch file
common_patterns.example: SWE-agent: git add -A && git diff --cached > patch.diff

common_patterns.when_to_use: Each agent task creates its own branch + opens PR for human review
common_patterns.example: GitHub Copilot Coding Agent uses copilot/* branch prefix

common_patterns.when_to_use: Prevent dual-ownership of files across parallel agents
common_patterns.example: parallel-cc: agents declare exclusive/shared access to files before modifying

common_patterns.when_to_use: High-stakes chunks; exploit LLM non-determinism to get best solution
common_patterns.example: N agents tackle same chunk; orchestrator picks best output via review

gotchas.issue: Agent Teams do NOT automatically isolate agents into worktrees
gotchas.solution: Must add isolation: worktree to each agent's frontmatter, or manage worktrees manually in the orchestrator
Add .claude/worktrees/ to .gitignore; Claude Code auto-removes worktrees with no changes on exit; Cursor limits to 20
Per-worktree port allocation: BASE_PORT + (WORKTREE_INDEX * 10) + SERVICE_OFFSET; separate DB instances per worktree

gotchas.issue: No ExitWorktree tool — CWD is locked to worktree for session
gotchas.solution: Claude Code Issue #29436 (open); current workaround: start a new session outside the worktree

gotchas.issue: Parallel agents rewriting the same files
gotchas.solution: Plan phase must define file ownership per chunk; mark non-overlapping file regions; use File Claims registry
Symlink node_modules and other gitignored build dirs (parallel-code pattern)

examples.title: Claude Code parallel chunk-coders with worktree isolation
examples.description: Spawn two parallel chunk-coder agents each in their own worktree
examples.code:
# In agent frontmatter (.claude/agents/chunk-coder.md):
---
name: chunk-coder
isolation: worktree
---

# Orchestrator spawns two coders — each gets .claude/worktrees/worktree-<name>/
